title: Close G1R
decision: Accept the independently recalculated G1R environment, action, recurrent, failure-mode and provenance contract as SUCCEEDED / PASS.
rationale: All original G1 criteria and remediation requirements passed on final-source evidence.
revisit_trigger: A reproducible environment or action-contract defect appears in later work.

title: Authorize G2/R1 and strict evaluation
decision: Implement G2 and parallel R1, expand the dashboard fully, use Kaggle notebooks for heavy workflows and enforce strict gold-oriented evaluation thresholds.
rationale: G1R is closed; the remaining schedule requires parallel model and meta intelligence work without weakening evidence gates.
revisit_trigger: A threshold is proven infeasible for reasons unrelated to policy strength, or the competition/runtime contract changes.
